teaser.en: Named after the gall bladder because it is so bitter, and its seeds hang in a neat row under each leaf.
teaser.sw: Umepewa jina la mfuko wa nyongo kwa sababu ni mchungu mno, na mbegu zake huning'inia kwa mstari nadhifu chini ya kila jani.
teaser.dg: Unaihwa dzina ra chifuko cha nyongo kpwa sababu una utsungu sana, na tembeze zinabwadzika mstari sawa-sawa photsi ya chila kodza.

summary.en: *Chihumbo utsungu* is a tiny, bitter weed whose fruits line up beneath its leafy branchlets. Both its Digo names come from things you can see or taste.
summary.sw: *Chihumbo utsungu* ni gugu dogo sana na chungu, ambalo matunda yake hupangana chini ya vitawi vyake vyenye majani. Majina yake yote mawili ya Kidigo yanatokana na mambo yanayoonekana au kuonjwa.
summary.dg: *Chihumbo utsungu* ni mbondo mdide sana wa utsungu, ambao matundage ganakala mstari photsi ya panda ndide zenye makodza. Madzinage mairi ga Chidigo ganalavywa kula vitu vinavyoonekana kpwa matso au vinavyomanyikana kpwa lilimi.

about.en: *Phyllanthus amarus* is a small, upright annual herb, usually under 50 cm tall. Its side branches carry two neat rows of tiny oval leaves, so each one looks like a single feathery compound leaf. Tiny greenish flowers and then small round fruits hang in a row underneath, along the branchlet. The whole plant tastes very bitter, and *amarus* means bitter in Latin. Digo identify it by the look of the whole plant.
about.sw: *Phyllanthus amarus* ni mmea mdogo wa msimu mmoja unaosimama wima, kwa kawaida chini ya sm 50 kwa urefu. Matawi yake ya pembeni hubeba safu mbili nadhifu za majani madogo sana ya umbo la yai, kwa hiyo kila tawi huonekana kama jani moja la mchanganyiko lililo kama unyoya. Maua madogo sana ya rangi ya kijani, na baadaye matunda madogo ya mviringo, huning'inia kwa mstari upande wa chini, kufuata kitawi. Mmea mzima una ladha chungu sana, na *amarus* maana yake ni chungu kwa Kilatini. Wadigo huutambua kwa sura ya mmea mzima.
about.dg: *Phyllanthus amarus* ni mmea mdide unaoima chocho, unaokala na moyo kpwa mwaka mmwenga tu, na mara nyinji tauzidi sentimita 50. Pandaze za kanda-kanda zina mistari miiri sawa-sawa ya makodza madide sana ga umbo ra tumbi, kpwa hivyo chila panda inaonekana dza kodza rimwenga renye makodza madide manji dza nyoya. Maruwa madide sana ga rangi ya chijani, na bada yao matunda madide ga duara, ganabwadzika mstari photsi ya panda ndide, kulunga urewe. Mmea wosi una utsungu sana, na *amarus* manage ni 'utsungu' kpwa Chilatini. Adigo anaumanya kpwa kulola umbo ra mmea wosi.

where.en: It is a common weed of farms, gardens, roadsides and waste ground throughout the tropics.
where.sw: Ni gugu la kawaida la mashambani, bustanini, kando ya barabara na kwenye ardhi isiyotumika kote katika maeneo ya tropiki.
where.dg: Ni mbondo wa kawaida wa minda, busitani, kanda-kanda ya njira na phatu phasiporimwa, kpwenye tsi zosi za dzoho.

uses.en: Pakia records no Digo use. Elsewhere in the tropics the plant is widely used in herbal medicine, especially for liver complaints, fevers and kidney stones; the English name 'stonebreaker' comes from that.
uses.sw: Pakia hakuandika matumizi yoyote ya Kidigo. Kwingineko katika maeneo ya tropiki mmea huu hutumika sana katika tiba ya mitishamba, hasa kwa matatizo ya ini, homa na mawe ya figo; jina la Kiingereza *stonebreaker* ('mvunja mawe') linatokana na hilo.
uses.dg: Pakia kaandika matumizi ga Adigo. Kpwenye tsi zanjina za dzoho mmea uhu nkuhumirwa sana kpwa dawa za chienyeji, zaidi kpwa makongo ga ini, homa na mawe ga figo; dzina ra Chingereza 'stonebreaker' ('chivundza mawe') rinalavywa kula phapho.

names.en: *Chihumbo utsungu* is the Digo word for the gall bladder. Mgombato glosses it in Swahili as *mfuko wa nyongo*. Pakia explains that the plant is named after the gall bladder because of its bitter taste (*utsungu*, bitterness), much as *mtsunga wa utsungu*, the bitter vegetable, is named for its taste. The second name, *mvyarira nyuma*, means 'producing from behind': the plant bears (*vyala*) its fruits at the back (*nyuma*) of the leaves. Its relative *Phyllanthus reticulatus* is called *mkpwamba lungo*.
names.sw: *Chihumbo utsungu* ni neno la Kidigo la mfuko wa nyongo. Mgombato analieleza kwa Kiswahili kama *mfuko wa nyongo*. Pakia anaeleza kwamba mmea huu umepewa jina la mfuko wa nyongo kwa sababu ya ladha yake chungu (*utsungu*, uchungu), kama vile *mtsunga wa utsungu*, mboga chungu, ulivyopewa jina kutokana na ladha yake. Jina la pili, *mvyarira nyuma*, maana yake ni 'unaozaa kwa nyuma': mmea huzaa (*vyala*) matunda yake upande wa nyuma (*nyuma*) wa majani. Jamaa yake *Phyllanthus reticulatus* huitwa *mkpwamba lungo*.
names.dg: *Chihumbo utsungu* ni neno ra Chidigo ra chifuko cha nyongo. Mgombato inarielezera kpwa Chiswahili dza *mfuko wa nyongo*. Pakia anaeleza kukala mmea uhu ukaihwa dzina ra chifuko cha nyongo kpwa sababu ya utsunguwe (*utsungu*), dza vira *mtsunga wa utsungu*, mboga ya utsungu, ulivyoihwa kpwa ladhaye. Dzina ra phiri, *mvyarira nyuma*, maneno kpwa maneno ni 'unaovyala kula nyuma': mmea unavyala (*vyala*) matundage nyuma (*nyuma*) ya makodza. Nduguye *Phyllanthus reticulatus* unaihwa *mkpwamba lungo*.

reason.dg: Nao ukaihwa dzina kpwa sababu ya utsunguwe
